name: Alpha Metallurgical Resources
outlook:
What Alpha Metallurgical Resources says to expect

  • Calendar 2027: shipmentsFor sales volumes, Alpha expects to ship between 13.1 million and 14.1 million metallurgical tons, as well as another 1.2 million to 1.6 million tons of incidental thermal coal, bringing total 2027 shipment expectations to a range of 14.3 million to 15.7 million tons for the year.
  • Calendar 2027: cost of coal salesAlpha projects 2027 cost of coal sales of between $104.00 and $110.00 per ton.
  • Calendar 2027: capital expendituresThe company expects capital expenditures, including carryover, development and maintenance capital, in the range of $145 million to $165 million.
  • Calendar 2027: cash tax rateThe company expects a 2027 cash tax rate of between 0% and 5%.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 6, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
